name: Race Horses
creator: Gorilla Grafters
redeem: Open Race Horses on Roblox and wait for your stable to load.
Click the Codes button, a price tag icon on the left side of the screen.
Paste a code into the text box.
Press Redeem and the food is added to your inventory.
notes:
Race Horses is an idle racing game from Gorilla Grafters, released on Roblox in June 2026. You buy eggs, hatch horses with random coats, eye sizes and traits, and enter them in a race that starts every minute. Any horse can win, but better horses earn more cash, which you spend on more eggs and stable upgrades. Your stable keeps earning while you are offline.

Codes give horse food such as Carrots, Beetroot, Pineapples, Pumpkins and Golden Apples. Caring for your horses gives them bonus XP, and Golden Apples seem to be the most valuable treat since codes only hand out one at a time, so save them for your best horse. New codes arrive with updates and seasonal events and are posted in the game's Discord.

faq.q: Where is the codes button in Race Horses?
faq.a: It is the price tag icon on the left side of the screen. Click it, paste a code and press Redeem.

faq.q: What should I do with the food from Race Horses codes?
faq.a: Feed it to your horses. Caring for them gives an XP bonus, which helps them improve faster.
It came out with the autumn update at the end of September 2026. Seasonal codes like this can stop working when the event ends, so claim it soon.

tips: Spend your first cash on eggs so your stable fills up. More horses give you more runners for the race that starts every minute, and more chances to earn.
Look closely at each horse you hatch. Coats, eye size and traits are random, and the ultra-rare traits and shiny variants are the ones worth keeping.
The Index rewards you for collecting different horses, so hatching a wide variety pays off, not just hatching the fastest ones.
Put some cash into stable upgrades before you log off. Your stable keeps earning while you are away, and upgrades raise how fast that money comes in.
useRewards: Every Race Horses code gives horse food, so all of the rewards go toward caring for your horses and the XP bonus that comes with it. The big stacks of Carrots and Beetroot are easy to spread across the whole stable. The smaller piles of Pineapples and Pumpkins suit the horses you race most. Redeem PUMPKINPATCH first, because seasonal codes often stop working once the event is over.
